Fourfold Root Key.description: Four tuned iron runes bound around a living root. Unsellable raid quest key.

Rekindled Depth-Lantern.description: The Tollkeeper's bell containing the flame stolen by the Lantern-Eater. Unsellable raid quest key.

Hunter's Star Chart.description: A chart written on astrolabe glass and chimera hide. Unsellable raid quest key.

Concordance of Dawn and Dusk.description: Twelve signatures written in Lastlight. Unsellable raid quest key.

Verdant Rune Piece.description: A broken green rune whose lines rearrange like roots seeking water. Awakens Rank I hero runes with guaranteed success.

Tidal Rune Piece.description: A blue-black rune fragment that feels heavier below the heart. Deepens hero runes to Rank II with guaranteed success.

Astral Rune Piece.description: A glassy rune piece showing a different constellation to each observer. Deepens hero runes to Rank III with guaranteed success.

Eclipse Rune Piece.description: A pale fragment casting a dark shadow in every direction. Perfects hero runes at Rank IV with guaranteed success.

Pathless Ember.description: A pale ember that burns backward, holding the memory of every road not taken. Rarely surrendered by defeated raid bosses.

Seal of Reflection.description: A retired amber seal kept as a memento. Ascension ranks can now be reassigned freely within the current path, so this item is no longer consumed or crafted.

Sigil of Rebirth.description: Shattering this violet sigil releases a hero from their Ascendant Path, refunding every point and reopening all four paths. Consumed on use.

Colossus Heartwood.description: Living heartwood cut only after Orrun chooses to stop walking.

Abyssal Beacon Core.description: A warm lantern core that continued burning beneath impossible pressure.

Fallen Star Prism.description: A many-sided prism formed from the constellation Veyra could not consume.

First-Dawn Ember.description: A white ember left when the eclipse releases the first dawn.

Thornwake Cleaver.description: An Ironbark Blade awakened with Colossus Heartwood. Open the Bark applies 8% vulnerability for two turns on the first critical hit, with a four-turn cooldown.

Rootguard Falchion.description: A defensive Heartwood blade. Guarding Root grants a 5% Max HP barrier after a successful counter, once per turn.

Canopy Recurve.description: A Heartwood bow dealing 20% more damage to arena objects and linked enemies.

Briarline Ballista.description: Every fifth basic ranged hit splinters into another enemy for 60% damage.

Grovewake Crook.description: Using an active skill heals the lowest-HP ally for 4% Max HP, with a three-turn cooldown.

Sporeheart Focus.description: Magic hits reduce enemy regeneration and healing received by 25% for two turns.

Anchorfall Saber.description: The first direct hit each encounter deals 30% less damage and grants 20 Threat for three turns.

Undertow Reaver.description: Below 50% HP, Lifesteal rises by 6 and outgoing damage by 10%.

Stormline Arbalest.description: The first ranged critical each turn lowers raid Pressure by 3 and deals 15% bonus damage.

Quiet-Tide Repeater.description: Basic attacks have a 12% chance to Silence for 1 turn; bosses instead receive -8% Attack for 1 turn.

Bellwake Staff.description: Every fourth active skill cleanses one effect from the lowest-HP affected ally.

Pressureglass Censer.description: Magic damage rises by 12% above 60 Pressure; magic criticals lower Pressure by 2.

Starfang Severer.description: Each action matching a Melee sign gains +4% Damage, stacking up to 3 times (+12%) until the sign changes.

Orbitbreaker Blade.description: Counters remove an enemy defense buff or ignore 12 boss Defense.

Comet-Hunt Bow.description: The first hit after the raid sign becomes Ranged is guaranteed to critically hit.

Patternpiercer.description: Ignores half of temporary Evade and deals 18% more damage to marked or vulnerable targets.

Triune Astrolabe.description: When the wielder completes a Magic sign, restore 6% Max MP and 5% Max HP to the lowest-HP ally.

Voidglass Eye.description: After the wielder hits an enemy, the next different attack type against it deals +15% Damage; then that enemy has a 2-turn cooldown.

Dawnroad Greatblade.description: After Total Eclipse, the next melee attack deals 40% bonus damage and heals 8% Max HP.

Duskward Aegisblade.description: The first physical and magical hit each encounter are reduced by 25%.

Horizon-Splitter.description: Critical hits during Dusk generate 50% more Lastlight and ignore 10 Defense.

Road-Without-End.description: Every sixth basic attack repeats at 50% power against the healthiest enemy and cannot miss.

Staff of the First Morning.description: Healing during Dawn generates +50% Lastlight; overhealing grants a barrier up to 8% of the target's Max HP.

Nullstar Lantern.description: During Total Eclipse, the wielder deals +18% Damage; the first lethal hit each raid leaves them at 1 HP.

Heart of the Marching Grove.description: The first time the wearer falls below 35% HP each encounter, gain a 20% Max HP barrier and cleanse attack reduction. Unique-equipped.

raid_set_bonus.name: Marching Heartwood
raid_set_bonus.description: Equip this unique accessory with a crafted March of the Rootbound weapon your class can wield. Shared Roots adapts to the wearer's class type, canonical weapon type, and the completing weapon's variant.

Tank.name: Shared Roots
Tank.description: When Road Stands triggers, every other living ally gains a barrier equal to 3% of their Max HP.

DPS.name: Shared Roots
DPS.description: When Road Stands triggers, every other living ally deals 6% more damage for two turns.

Healer.name: Shared Roots
Healer.description: When Road Stands triggers, every other living ally is healed for 3% of their Max HP.

Support.name: Shared Roots
Support.description: When Road Stands triggers, every other living ally gains 4 MP.

Tank.name: Shared Roots
Tank.description: With a critical-variant weapon, Road Stands grants every other living ally +8% Counter Chance for two turns.

DPS.name: Shared Roots
DPS.description: With a critical-variant weapon, Road Stands grants every other living ally +8% Critical Chance for two turns.

Healer.name: Shared Roots
Healer.description: With a critical-variant weapon, Road Stands grants every other living ally +8% Healing for two turns.

Support.name: Shared Roots
Support.description: With a critical-variant weapon, Road Stands grants every other living ally +8% Immunity for two turns.

Bell of the Lightless Deep.description: Every fifth action removes all negative effects from the two lowest-HP allies, then heals each for 5% Max HP. Unique-equipped.

raid_set_bonus.name: Beacon of the Deep
raid_set_bonus.description: Equip this unique accessory with a crafted Lightless Armada weapon your class can wield. Bellwake Resonance adapts to the wearer's class type, canonical weapon type, and the completing weapon's variant.

Tank.name: Bellwake Resonance
Tank.description: Each ally selected by Sound Without Air also gains a barrier equal to 4% of their Max HP.

DPS.name: Bellwake Resonance
DPS.description: Each ally selected by Sound Without Air also deals 8% more damage for two turns.

Healer.name: Bellwake Resonance
Healer.description: Each ally selected by Sound Without Air is also healed for an extra 4% of their Max HP.

Support.name: Bellwake Resonance
Support.description: Each ally selected by Sound Without Air also gains 8 MP.

Tank.name: Bellwake Resonance
Tank.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each selected ally instead gains +10 Defense for two turns.

DPS.name: Bellwake Resonance
DPS.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each selected ally instead gains +15 Critical Damage for two turns.

Healer.name: Bellwake Resonance
Healer.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each selected ally instead gains +10% Healing for two turns.

Support.name: Bellwake Resonance
Support.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each selected ally instead gains +8% Critical Chance for two turns.

Veyra's Unswallowed Eye.description: The first successful party hit of each attack type adds 1% vulnerability, up to 3%. Multiple Eyes share this cap. Unique-equipped.

raid_set_bonus.name: Unswallowed Pattern
raid_set_bonus.description: Equip this unique accessory with a crafted Hunt of the Broken Sky weapon your class can wield. Pattern Made Whole adapts to the wearer's class type, canonical weapon type, and the completing weapon's variant.

Tank.name: Pattern Made Whole
Tank.description: When the party completes the pattern, each paired wearer gains a barrier equal to 8% of their Max HP, once per encounter.

DPS.name: Pattern Made Whole
DPS.description: When the party completes the pattern, each paired wearer deals 12% more damage for two turns, once per encounter.

Healer.name: Pattern Made Whole
Healer.description: When the party completes the pattern, each paired wearer is healed for 6% of their Max HP, once per encounter.

Support.name: Pattern Made Whole
Support.description: When the party completes the pattern, each paired wearer gains 10 MP, once per encounter.

Tank.name: Pattern Made Whole
Tank.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each paired wearer instead gains +12% Counter Chance for two turns, once per encounter.

DPS.name: Pattern Made Whole
DPS.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each paired wearer's next attack is instead guaranteed to critically hit, once per encounter.

Healer.name: Pattern Made Whole
Healer.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each paired wearer instead gains +12% Healing for two turns, once per encounter.

Support.name: Pattern Made Whole
Support.description: With a critical-variant weapon, each paired wearer instead gains +10% Critical Chance for two turns, once per encounter.

Signet of the Last Road.description: Once per encounter, lethal damage leaves the wearer at 1 HP and grants the wearer and every living ally a 6% Max HP barrier. Unique-equipped.

raid_set_bonus.name: Concordance of the Last Road
raid_set_bonus.description: Equip this unique accessory with a crafted Last Road weapon your class can wield. Last Road Concordance adapts to the wearer's class type, canonical weapon type, and the completing weapon's variant.

Tank.name: Last Road Concordance
Tank.description: When the Signet prevents lethal damage, every living ally gains a barrier equal to 4% of their Max HP and +8 Defense for two turns.

DPS.name: Last Road Concordance
DPS.description: When the Signet prevents lethal damage, every living ally deals 12% more damage for two turns.

budget.note: throughput budget concentrated in one stat

Healer.name: Last Road Concordance
Healer.description: When the Signet prevents lethal damage, every living ally is healed for 5% of their Max HP and gains +8% Healing for two turns.

Support.name: Last Road Concordance
Support.description: When the Signet prevents lethal damage, every living ally gains 8% damage and 8% healing for two turns.

Tank.name: Last Road Concordance
Tank.description: With a critical-variant weapon, every living ally instead gains +8% Counter Chance and +10 Defense for two turns.

DPS.name: Last Road Concordance
DPS.description: With a critical-variant weapon, every living ally instead gains +8% Critical Chance and +15 Critical Damage for two turns.

Healer.name: Last Road Concordance
Healer.description: With a critical-variant weapon, every living ally is instead healed for 4% of their Max HP and gains +12% Healing for two turns.

Support.name: Last Road Concordance
Support.description: With a critical-variant weapon, every living ally instead gains +8% Critical Chance and +8% Immunity for two turns.

Melee.label: Melee
Melee.identity: contact pressure, counterplay, threat, and guarding

boolean_replacement.rationale: A guaranteed critical cannot be scaled by the payload rule; the Melee variant re-expresses the full cell budget as reliable contact damage at the same one-point-per-percent parity the sibling role cells of this raid/profile already use.

Ranged.label: Ranged
Ranged.identity: accuracy, critical delivery, and attack tempo

boolean_replacement.rationale: Guaranteed critical delivery is the Ranged identity itself; the Ranged variant intentionally shares the base cell payload at par instead of diluting it with a redundant critical rider.

Magic.label: Magic
Magic.identity: spell throughput, mana efficiency, and magical support

boolean_replacement.rationale: The Magic variant re-expresses the guaranteed-critical budget as spell throughput plus mana efficiency at the same one-point-per-percent parity, keeping the DPS role identity primary.
